messages:
matt: Midweek quick sweep — short updates + asks.
matt: Pipeline highlights: AcmeCorp in legal (SSO cert + network diagram requested), NovaGrid POC passed (pricing question), CortexA stalled — they want p95 lat and memory footprints for the model variant.
matt: Blockers: security wants SOC2 scope + network diagram for Acme before we can push Dedicated contract. Also need an answer on whether we can enable private endpoints for NovaGrid by end of week.
olivia: I can draft the Acme pricing addendum today. matt — can you confirm expected Q1 seat commit? :writing_hand:
matt: @olivia estimate 120 seats, but Acme asked for 90 guaranteed + burst to 150.
raj: I’ll pull the VPC diagram and update it with the private endpoint notes. Should have a first pass in ~2 hours. Will post link here.
leo: For NovaGrid, requirement is just private endpoint + HIPAA BA if they want PHI. We have the BA template ready — I can send.
sara: Looping in Sam from security for SOC2 and retention Qs. @sam can you confirm timeline for SOC2 scope review?
sam: On it. I’ll review Acme's addendum + scope. Expect initial comments by EOD. Also need clarification on where logs will be retained and access controls.
security-bot: Automated: SOC2 checklist (v3) available at https://internal.redwood/sec/soc2-checklist — attach reference ID #SOC2-V3
matt: Raj when you post the VPC diagram can you also call out which subnets will host the inference pool? sales needs that for the contract.
raj: yep — will annotate subnets + expected egress IP ranges.
olivia: Quick note: if Acme wants burst to 150 we should add a burst-rate clause to avoid SLA mismatch. Drafting language now.
leo: I’ll attach the BA + existing customer redaction examples after lunch.
sara: Blocker for CortexA: engineering needs to give p95 latency on the 8k sequence test. @eng-runtime ping? (not in this thread) If anyone has historical numbers I can forward.
matt: Thx all — next steps: raj (VPC diagram + subnet annotation), olivia (pricing addendum), sam (security review). If folks can drop small updates here as they finish that would be great. :thumbsup:
matt: FYI — will escalate Acme legal deadline to priority tomorrow if we don’t get SOC2 scope confirmed.
leo: Noted. I’ll prep BA and redaction examples by 15:30 PST.
raj: Diagram posted: https://files.redwood/internal/diagrams/acme-vpc-v2.png — comments welcome.
olivia: Added pricing draft to the Google folder and pinged legal for review. link: https://drive.google.com/acme-pricing-draft
sam: Security review started. I flagged a data retention question re: embeddings TTL — can someone confirm default retention policy?
matt: Default embeddings TTL is 90 days (customer can request longer with contract). Posting that to security thread now.
sara: Great — that should cover the retention question. I’ll update the SOC2 scope doc with that note.
matt: Closing the loop here. If anything urgent pops up overnight, flag in #oncall-sales or DM me. Thanks everyone.
